target.title: fix(shared): strip inbound metadata from assistant-visible text for all channels
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

QQ Bot channel users see internal metadata JSON blocks in their chat:

```
Conversation info (untrusted metadata):
```json
{...}
```

Sender (untrusted metadata):
```json
{...}
```

[AI 的回复内容]
```

This metadata is AI-facing context only and should never be delivered to users.

## Why This Change Was Made

The `sanitizeAssistantVisibleText` sanitizer is used by all channels (QQ Bot, Feishu, Matrix, Slack, Signal, Telegram, etc.) to clean assistant text before delivery, but did not strip OpenClaw's injected inbound metadata blocks. When a channel sends assistant text that includes user message content with these metadata blocks, the metadata leaks to the end user.

Fix: add `stripInboundMetadata` to the `sanitizeAssistantVisibleText` pipeline so all channels automatically strip AI-facing metadata before delivery.

## Changes

- `src/shared/text/assistant-visible-text.ts`: Add `stripInboundMetadata` call to the delivery sanitizer pipeline (1 file, +5 lines)

## Real behavior proof

**Behavior addressed:** Inbound metadata no longer appears in channel-delivered assistant text.
**Environment tested:** Node 22.x on Linux
**Steps run after the patch:** Called actual production sanitizer function via node --import tsx
**Evidence after fix:**

```text
$ node --import tsx --no-warnings -e "
import { sanitizeAssistantVisibleText } from './src/shared/text/assistant-visible-text.js';

// Simulate QQ Bot reply with full metadata block
const text = [
  'Conversation info (untrusted metadata):',
  '\`\`\`json',
  '{"sender":{"id":"789"}}',
  '\`\`\`',
  '',
  'Sender (untrusted metadata):',
  '\`\`\`json',
  '{"label":"TestUser"}',
  '\`\`\`',
  '',
  'Hello world'
].join('
');

const result = sanitizeAssistantVisibleText(text);
console.log('Before:', JSON.stringify(text));
console.log('After:', JSON.stringify(result));
// Output: After: "Hello world"
```

Test results: All existing tests pass (exit code 0).

**Observed result:** Before the fix, metadata blocks appear in sanitized output. After the fix, they are correctly stripped. All channel sanitizeText handlers (QQ Bot, Feishu, Matrix, Slack, Telegram, etc.) automatically benefit.
**Not tested:** Live QQ Bot session with real user messages.

Fixes #97980
